LTTH Version 1.3.34 Release Notes

Version 1.3.34 releases WebGPU Fireworks 3.0.0 with five new premium finales, PyroDSL, and a complete Show Designer.

- NEW: Five premium finales expand the library to nine built-in shows and 27 curated short, medium, and long variants
- NEW: PyroDSL, the visual Show Designer, and a revisioned Custom Show API add validated authoring, derivation, publishing, import, and export
- NEW: GPU primitives and curated glyphs support layered professional shells while particle budgets preserve core choreography under load
- IMPROVED: Explicit live previews, deterministic queue snapshots, and Goal and Superfan show overrides integrate custom and built-in finales safely
- IMPROVED: Show titles, controls, runtime status, and Designer surfaces are available in German, English, Spanish, and French
- IMPROVED: WebGPU Fireworks plugin version advanced to 3.0.0
